## 2026-04-13 cleanup note

- Fixtures remain source-controlled test data, but they are not imported directly by the default
  active suite unless a current test explicitly opts in.
- The canonical filename parser unit coverage is in `tests/unit/test_filename_parser.py`; fixture
  expansion should add to active tests rather than restore removed duplicate modules.
- Disposed golden/performance harness files are no longer kept under `tests/`; recover them only
  from the 2026-04-13 local archive bundle if you need to inspect old behavior.
